attachment_and_tiling.dependencies: Every original primitive t/m support plus family binding/marking/context dependencies, including pending/unseen candidates, enters the same complete forward/reverse graph. Global DEAD before UNKNOWN/forced/earliest generation and exact full rollback remain mandatory.
attachment_and_tiling.domain_scope: The historical one-block-per-cell family inventory changes high-level grammar and finite envelope. Do not call it the unchanged arithmetic24 primitive-row universe. If a macro-tile inventory is later introduced, declare it separately and prove its expansion/embedding and compare costs at primitive level.
attachment_and_tiling.first_integration: ADVICE_ONLY: after unchanged real global BRANCH select one independently current-legal incident primitive anchor from one validated family. Other members are pending preferences, not installations or markings. Revalidate each only when the unchanged global scheduler later chooses its row. Preserve family preference lineage in existing child checkpoint/rollback; full canonical primitive fallback remains available.
attachment_and_tiling.point_authority: Point compilation expresses consistency constraints; it does not prove the formulas. Native full primitive checking remains authoritative. New elimination markings need a versioned proved-redundancy certificate in exact scope, or an explicitly restricted hypothesis lane; a proposed family never supplies degree0/1 or library-based pruning.
attachment_and_tiling.translation: Compile a frozen ground expansion to exact t/m point data under a declared translation only. Preserve original member preimages, ordered offsets/ports, metadata and all remote marking support. No rotations, polygon geometry, arbitrary reindexing or same-formula tile identity shortcut. Assignments equal where overlapping; t sums obey host capacity.

counterexample_obligations: Same first receptor with incompatible second MP port must not match; reordered ports and inconsistent repeated meta bindings reject.
Capture-producing formula substitution, free/bound-name collision, escaped eigenvariable, incomplete Gamma and forged fresh-name scope must reject or be explicitly outside profile.
Wrong theory/signature/parameter/predicate arity/profile/epoch or fake local assumptions must not reuse an admission.
Cycle/unregistered dependency, forged expansion, internal wrong reference, wrong output node and unavailable host primitive must fail closed.
Overlapping unequal m, overcapacity t, missing remote dependency, duplicated full key and equal digest/unequal full preimage require exact handling; no real collision occurrence is asserted.
Unknown membership/expansion/budget, empty proposal prefix or absent library result must not imply dead/forced/excluded candidates; complete base fallback and rollback survive.

Finite tested instances do not establish universal schema soundness. A semantic countermodel can refute a claimed sequent; failure to find one is not a proof. Native expansion must still check every used ground instance/root.

gates.accept: Exact native dialect, primitive field/arity map, theory/signature, Gamma occurrences, profile and original epoch checked; shared descriptor alone confers no theorem transfer.
All ordered input/output/context constraints unified together; wrong second port, inconsistent repeated metavariable and port order mutations rejected.
Capture, illicit eigenvariable escape, incomplete original Gamma, forbidden name/arity and fresh-name/profile exhaustion handled explicitly; resource UNKNOWN never reclassified.
Every member is an actual original primitive in the active host; no unsupported block/tautology/distribution/induction imports; nested calls expand with full dependency and reference checks.

Current arithmetic retains the same primitive rows, exact keys and full canonical fallback; family advice supplies one current legal anchor only, and pending members wait for the unchanged global scheduler at every subsequent step.
Whole compatible t/m union, full preimage identities, remote and unseen support dependencies, branch preferences and nested exact checkpoint rollback independently checked.
Primitive expansion size/work and all cold matching/check/output cost charged; macro-call counts cannot replace primitive row/budget measurements; no runtime pass asserted by Source reasoning.

first_implementation_acceptance.ordinary_comparison: If Root later elects measurements, compare no-family ordering versus validated-family ordering over the SAME original primitive universe, host input/epoch, limits and final verifier. Any proved marking-elimination lane is separate and requires its own scoped redundancy proof. This is a testable proposal, not an authorized actual or predicted gain.
required_artifacts: complete family preimage and all-port binding
full primitive expansion with node/ordered-port origin map
unchanged full final native root-check receipt when a complete proof exists
expanded cost and exact rollback evidence
first_implementation_acceptance.scope: Proposal-only descriptor/matcher/expander on existing original primitive members; no library activation, one-cell block replacement or new mathematical rule.

identity.family: SHA256 of canonical complete descriptor excluding family_id/provenance-only display labels, plus full literal preimage comparison. Equal digest with unequal full descriptor rejects, never merges. Provenance remains separately retained and Source-bound.
identity.index: An alpha-normalized or outer-constructor receptor signature is an index hint only. Exact native literal formulas, scope and full preimages determine admissibility; no hash injectivity or alpha-equality shortcut.
identity.instance: Full family preimage, exact substitution/renaming, original host rule/theory/signature/context/profile/Source binding, ordered port bindings and complete expansion. Preserve original primitive placement keys separately; cluster identity does not replace them.

illustration.label: HUMAN_SPECIFIED_DESIGN_ONLY_NOT_DISCOVERED_OR_RUNTIME_CHECKED
illustration.scope: One generic two-MP composition; no arithmetic term, geometry theorem, target formula, row allocation, donor or branch route supplied.

instance_packet.pending_rule: If occupied=False, fact_accepted=False and only a future preference/obligation is present. Occupancy alone also does not replace native proof checking.
instance_packet.proof_accepted: False except a separate exact native whole-root receipt; HOST_LOCAL_SEQUENT_CHECKED is relative to explicit premises, not ROOT_PROOF_CHECKED. Current proposals never manufacture either receipt.

minimal_next_implementation: Implement a read-only typed descriptor +all-port matcher/expander adapter first, using only the one human-specified schema and genuine host primitive membership checks. Keep it proposal-only until independent instance expansion and unchanged final host proof checking are integrated. Adapt both host namespaces separately; do not activate an old donor inventory. Root chooses any actual later.
objective: A reusable typed family interface indexed by all receptor ports, shared as syntax/proposal machinery across arithmetic and symbolic Hilbert geometry. Theories, primitive verifiers, finite universes and proof authority stay host-specific.

overlap_dedup_and_cost.budget: Charge generation, matching, substitution, expansion, all independent checks, output and caller overhead to the unchanged owning window. Macro call count is reported separately from expanded primitive rows. Shared exact nodes count once as placements but all actual verifier work and ordered edge uses remain counted. Resource interruption is UNKNOWN, not exhaustion.
overlap_dedup_and_cost.dedup: Never dedup by conclusion, alpha-class or digest alone. Check complete family/instance/member preimages on ID reuse. Distinct indexed assumptions and ordered source ports are not interchangeable. No automatic reuse of a historically checked instance in another state/profile/theory.
overlap_dedup_and_cost.overlap: Validate the complete union across all proposed members and external interfaces, not merely pairwise adjacency or one port. Shared internal nodes require identical primitive key/preimage/translation/host scope; repeated input edges remain explicit even when they point to one node.

proposed_interfaces.check_complete_proof: The exact existing host native verifier checks the complete expanded root proof with original theory, ordered Gamma and exact target. A native block protocol may admit ground local sequents if that host supports them; arithmetic six-rule host has no block primitive, so it receives only fully expanded original commands. Never fabricate a new Gamma or isolated facts to reuse another host admission receipt.
proposed_interfaces.check_local_cluster: (*,original_authority,current_point_state,instance,expanded_members,tick)->READY_LOCAL_CLUSTER|OUTSIDE_HOST_PROFILE|REJECTED|UNKNOWN. Independently rebuild every original primitive, ordered reference, membership, complete union and current whole-point legality. READY does not accept pending premises or a theorem.
proposed_interfaces.describe_receptor: (*,host_binding,checked_state,port_obligation,tick)->{host_binding,context_scope,ordered_port_pattern,occupancy,PENDING_or_occupied,source_binding}; extract actual point data, never a supplied target route.
proposed_interfaces.expand_instance: (*,descriptor,substitution,renaming,ordered_port_bindings,host_binding,tick)->{full_primitive_DAG,dependency_first_closure,node_origin_map,output_node_refs,full_scope_obligations,costs}. Expand nested calls acyclically; no executable payloads.
proposed_interfaces.match_family: (*,descriptor,receptors,declared_finite_parameter_enumerator,tick)->lazy bounded instance proposals. Join all ports in one environment; unbound parameters enumerate fairly in the declared host universe. Empty bounded prefix is not absence of a family or candidate.

substitution_and_hygiene.requirement: Match all ordered input patterns, relevant outputs and context requirements using one environment. Never accept only the first MP antecedent or infer an unsupported second port. Check term/formula kind, predicate arity and complete repeated-variable consistency.

Formula/term meta parameters denote explicit abstractions. Substitute actual term arguments into formal variables simultaneously, respecting lexical binder IDs. An intended dependence on a bound variable must be an explicit abstraction argument; accidental capture is forbidden. Rename conflicting binders with host-admissible fresh names before insertion.

Record the full template-variable-ID to native-name map and each alpha-renaming. Repeated literal binder strings do not identify scopes. Rebuild native ASTs and every primitive witness after renaming; alpha equivalence alone never satisfies a literal port/key comparison.

Recompute free variables against the complete current undischarged context, external input dependencies, scope frame and output restrictions. Arithmetic UG additionally requires a declared parameter absent from full original Gamma; legacy block generalization excludes all local premises. Existential witnesses must not escape context/conclusion. No fresh-name or parser-budget reset.

Check every resulting formula/term/primitive in the original finite membership language. Logical validity does not imply bounded representability. Definite nonmembership is OUTSIDE_HOST_PROFILE; unfinished name search/substitution/membership is UNKNOWN, never false pruning.

typed_semantics.Formula: Host formula AST; constructor/signature/scope/profile checked after instantiation. A FORMULA abstraction has explicit formal_variables and allowed external free variables. Each use supplies exactly its formal arity; repeated parameter occurrences use one simultaneous binding.
typed_semantics.HypothesisPort: Ordered undischarged context requirement. Binding retains exact original Gamma occurrence index and literal formula, including repeated equal occurrences. It is not a new axiom and cannot be silently discharged.
typed_semantics.InputPort: Ordered external derivation requirement. Repeated formulas/ports remain ordered. A common earlier source may satisfy several ports only if the explicit sharing policy and host references allow it. Pending unoccupied inputs are obligations, never facts.
typed_semantics.OutputPort: Literal formula plus the exact internal expansion node producing it. Multiple outputs expose actual primitive nodes, not additional axioms. Final theorem acceptance still belongs to the unchanged whole original-target verifier.
typed_semantics.PredicateSymbol: A declared host predicate name at exactly the recorded arity. Point/Line labels in geometry enumeration are not a new many-sorted kernel; any needed semantic sort facts must appear as explicit formula/hypothesis ports or proved host premises.
typed_semantics.Term: Host term AST with explicit free-variable allowance. Function symbols and arities remain those of the exact host declaration; no new constants/functions introduced by a binding.
typed_semantics.Variable: Unique template variable IDs distinguish binder occurrences from actual string names. Roles are free parameter, local bound, eigenvariable or equality hole. Ground mapping is scope-aware and injective where distinctness requires it; names must remain inside the declared host profile.
